CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), its presentation (explicit coordinate mapping) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly reported for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to a content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report names contents (color labels) and gives explicit attribute value mappings (coordinate sets).

D.rationale: An origin/status field (kind/history_estimate) is reported separately from the content mapping, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: The coordinate mapping explicitly states how the content is presented/represented for the referent/time.
